name: Default
shortDescription: IPTV and stream manager that imports M3U, Xtream Codes and EPG sources and serves channels as M3U, XMLTV, Xtream Codes API or HDHomeRun.

alerts.message: Web setup of the first admin account only accepts private network addresses. Open the site, note the IP shown on the setup page, set DISPATCHARR_SETUP_ALLOWED_IP to it and redeploy, or run python manage.py createsuperuser in the container terminal.
